changelog: **Employer verification gate (#1865, part 1):** `Company.verificationStatus` (`PENDING|VERIFIED|REJECTED|SUSPENDED`, **default `VERIFIED`** so every existing company stays visible; only self-signup will write `PENDING`) plus `verifiedAt`, `verifiedById`, `signupDomain`, `rejectionReason` — additive. The gate is in the queries: `visibleJobsWhere()` adds `VERIFIED_COMPANY_WHERE` inside the board's Prisma `where` (counts and pages stay right, detail 404s); publishing a requisition (`status: OPEN` on POST/PATCH) and `POST /api/company/outreach` answer `403 company_not_verified`. `POST /api/admin/companies/[id]/verification` (`approve|reject|suspend|reinstate`, `company.write`, guarded `updateMany`, `AuditLog` `COMPANY_VERIFICATION`, in-app notice to the company with the reason) and a `?verification=` filter + badge/actions on `/admin/companies`. `PUT /api/companies/[id]` now admits a COMPANY user for its own company, for six fields only (`protected_fields` names the rest). Pure rule in `src/lib/companyVerification.ts`, unit-tested; `docs/company-verification.md`.

en: Admins can now verify, reject or suspend employer accounts — a company that is not verified stays hidden from candidates and cannot publish roles. Company users can update their own profile (description, logo, industry, size, address, contact e-mail).
tr: Yöneticiler artık işveren hesaplarını doğrulayabiliyor, reddedebiliyor veya askıya alabiliyor — doğrulanmamış bir şirket adaylara görünmez ve ilan yayımlayamaz. Şirket kullanıcıları kendi profillerini (açıklama, logo, sektör, büyüklük, adres, iletişim e-postası) güncelleyebiliyor.
de: Admins können Arbeitgeberkonten jetzt verifizieren, ablehnen oder sperren – ein nicht verifiziertes Unternehmen bleibt für Kandidat:innen unsichtbar und kann keine Stellen veröffentlichen. Unternehmensnutzer:innen können ihr eigenes Profil (Beschreibung, Logo, Branche, Größe, Adresse, Kontakt-E-Mail) selbst pflegen.
